Report Description\\ NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: GULF OF MEXICO \\ POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 05-08-2023 REPORT TIME: 1330 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: BRETON SOUND BS0016 IMAGE DATE: 05-07-2023 IMAGE TIME: 1605 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°38"41" N/89°17"43" W AREA: 4.37 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THE POSSIBLE OIL SLICK WAS OBSERVED IN THE BRETON SOUND AREA JUST OFF THE LOUISIANA COAST. THE POSSIBLE OIL WAS COMPRISED OF TWO SEPARATE SLICKS. THE WESTERN SLICK MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 2.1NM X 0.9NM, WITH THE EASTERN SLICK APPROXIMATELY 4.5NM X 0.3NM. THE POSSIBLE SLICKS EXHIBITED BRIGHTER REFLECTANCE SURROUNDED BY A DARKER SHEEN. THE BRIGHT AREAS MAY HAVE BEEN AN INDICATION OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. THERE WERE PORTIONS OF THE SLICKS THAT ALSO APPEARED TO HAVE FEATHERING FEATURES, WHICH WAS CONSISTENT WITH THE 10-15KT SE WIND AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGERY. THIS AREA MAY HAVE BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH NRC #1366513 GIVEN ITS CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE SE. DUE TO THE APPEARANCE IN SATELLITE IMAGERY AND THE NEARBY NRC REPORT, THE CONFIDENCE LEVEL IS HIGH. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE POSSIBLE OIL SLICK IS UNKNOWN DUE TO THE AREA EXTENDING PAST THE EDGE OF THE SATELLITE IMAGERY. ADDITIONALLY, A POINT SOURCE COULD NOT BE DETERMINED. MAPS AND SHAPEFILES CAN BE ACCESSED AT: WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ ERMA: HTTPS://ERMA.NOAA.GOV/GULFOFMEXICO/ERMA.HTML#/LAYERS=1+51742&X=-89.3005495&Y=29.642696&Z=11&PANEL=LAYER

properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1292887
Incident Time: 2020-11-23 15:30:00
Nearest City: Georgiana, AL
Location: MM 549.50
Incident Type: RAILROAD
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: THREE NOTCH RAILROAD (AKON)
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 31.607222, -86.730833 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 100 gallon
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK CRASHED INTO THE SIDE OF THE ENGINE RUPTURING THE TANK AT A GRADE CROSSING. THE CALLER STATED THE COLLISION WAS NOT DUE TO FAULTY GRADE CROSSING FLASHERS OR DUE TO BRAKE FAILURE BY THE TRAIN. THE CALLER STATED IT IS SUSPECTED THAT THE TRUCK FAILED TO BREAK BEFORE THE GRADE CROSSING CAUSING THE COLLISION. THE CALLER STATED THAT THE TRAIN DID NOT DERAIL, HOWEVER IT DID RELEASE AN ESTIMATED 100 GALLONS OF DIESEL ONTO THE NEARBY ASPHALT AND GRAVEL. THERE WERE NO REPORTED INJURIES OR FATALITIES IN CONNECTION TO THIS INCIDENT. THE CALLER STATED THE ONLY DAMAGES WERE TO THE TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK, AND THE TRAIN ENGINE. THE COST OF THE DAMAGES ARE STILL UNKNOWN, THE HIGHWAY WAS CLOSED FOR ABOUT A HALF HOUR. THE MAIN TRAIN TRACK HAS BEEN CLOSED AND MAY REMAIN CLOSED FOR 24 HOURS. THE CALLER STATED THAT THIS IS NOT A PASSENGER TRAIN ROUTE AND THEY DO NOT EXPECT ANY PASSENGER TRAIN DELAYS. THE CALLER STATED THAT A CONTRACTOR IS IN ROUTE TO CLEAN THE SPILL

Report DescriptionCALLER STATES THAT DURING LUGGAGE LOADING, A BURNING SMELL AND SMOKE WAS DETECTED COMING FROM THE LOWER HOLD IN PIT 3 OF THE COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT. UPON INVESTIGATION, AN HP PAVILION 360 LAPTOP WAS DISCOVERED WITH EVIDENCE OF SCORCHING IN A PASSENGER"S BAG. THIS RESULTED IN THE LAPTOP MELTING ONTO AN AIR DRYER WITHIN THE BAG, CAUSING FUMES AND SMOKE TO BE RELEASED TO THE AIR. THE SMOKE CAUSED A MILD DIZZYING EFFECT TO SOME EMPLOYEES. THE LAPTOP AND BAG WERE REMOVED AND QUARANTINED INSIDE AN OFFICE. THE REST OF THE LUGGAGE CONTENTS WERE TRANSFERRED TO A NEW BAG AND PUT BACK ON THE FLIGHT. THIS CAUSED A 45 MINUTE DELAY FOR THE FLIGHT.

Report DescriptionCALLER STATES THAT DURING LUGGAGE LOADING, A BURNING SMELL AND SMOKE WAS DETECTED COMING FROM THE LOWER HOLD IN PIT 3 OF THE COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT. UPON INVESTIGATION, AN HP PAVILION 360 LAPTOP WAS DISCOVERED WITH EVIDENCE OF SCORCHING IN A PASSENGER"S BAG. THIS RESULTED IN THE LAPTOP MELTING ONTO AN AIR DRYER WITHIN THE BAG, CAUSING FUMES AND SMOKE TO BE RELEASED TO THE AIR. THE SMOKE CAUSED A MILD DIZZYING EFFECT TO SOME EMPLOYEES. THE LAPTOP AND BAG WERE REMOVED AND QUARANTINED INSIDE AN OFFICE. THE REST OF THE LUGGAGE CONTENTS WERE TRANSFERRED TO A NEW BAG AND PUT BACK ON THE FLIGHT. Report Description
///WEB REPORT/// A MINISCULE AMOUNT OF OIL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0812 THIS MORNING IN THE TAIL RACE IN FRONT OF UNIT # 1. ALTHOUGH THE SOURCE CANNOT BE VERIFIED AT THIS TIME, IT IS BELIEVED THE SHEEN MOST LIKELY CAME FROM UNIT #1 WHICH WAS PLACED OUT OF SERVICE ON 2/15/13 AT 1930 DUE TO EXCESSIVE VIBRATION. UNDER SUPERVISION THE UNIT WAS RESTARTED ABOUT 40 MINUTES LATER AT 2007 AND STOPPED AT 2011. ALL OIL LEVELS WERE CHECKED AFTER THIS INCIDENT ON THE 15TH AND NO DECREASES IN OIL LEVELS WERE FOUND. OIL ACCOUNTABILITY WILL BE DONE AGAIN TODAY TO VERIFY OIL LEVELS. BECAUSE THE CAUSE OF THE EXCESSIVE VIBRATION IS UNKNOWN IT IS DIFFICULT TO ACCURATELY IDENTIFY THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN. TODAY, MECHANICS WILL WORK TO PUT STOP LOGS AND HEAD GATES IN PLACE SO THEY MAY GAIN ACCESS TO INVESTIGATE THE INCIDENT THAT HAS OCCURRED. THE SHEEN APPEARED TO BE A COUPLE TABLESPOONS WORTH, ONLY ABOUT 4 INCHES BY 4 INCHES IN A COUPLE DIFFERENT AREAS IN THE TAILRACE. CURRENTLY BOOM IS BEING DEPLOYED TO CAPTURE ANY OIL THAT HAS BEEN DISCHARGED TO THE SNAKE RIVER MILE 70.3.

UNDER SUPERVISION THE UNIT WAS RESTARTED ABOUT 40 MINUTES LATER AT 2007 AND STOPPED AT 2011. ALL OIL LEVELS WERE CHECKED AFTER THIS INCIDENT ON THE 15TH AND NO DECREASES IN OIL LEVELS WERE FOUND. OIL ACCOUNTABILITY WILL BE DONE AGAIN TODAY TO VERIFY OIL LEVELS. BECAUSE THE CAUSE OF THE EXCESSIVE VIBRATION IS UNKNOWN IT IS DIFFICULT TO ACCURATELY IDENTIFY THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN. TODAY, MECHANICS WILL WORK TO PUT STOP LOGS AND HEAD GATES IN PLACE SO THEY MAY GAIN ACCESS TO INVESTIGATE THE INCIDENT THAT HAS OCCURRED. THE SHEEN APPEARED TO BE A COUPLE TABLESPOONS WORTH, ONLY ABOUT 4 INCHES BY 4 INCHES IN A COUPLE DIFFERENT AREAS IN THE TAILRACE. CURRENTLY BOOM IS BEING DEPLOYED TO CAPTURE ANY OIL THAT HAS BEEN DISCHARGED TO THE SNAKE RIVER MILE 70.3.
